bos_archivist.text: This is the passenger list of a ship from Liverpool, April 1847: Sullivan, Murphy, Kelly, Walsh. Most Irish emigrants sailed from Liverpool, after a crossing of the Irish Sea, then six weeks or more on the Atlantic.

And here, a Boston Pilot newspaper. Its 'Missing Friends' column ran for decades: notices from families trying to find each other. 'Information wanted of Mary Ryan, of Tipperary...' It's the saddest thing in the building.
